# ==========================================================================
# Pinned dependencies for ALBERT / BioBERT transformer training.
# Versions match the 2026 repo stack so the original Trainer API
# (evaluation_strategy=..., transformers.AdamW, etc.) works unchanged.
#
# NOTE: torch is installed separately in setup_env.sh with the correct CUDA
#       wheel index for the Blythe L40 GPUs, so it is intentionally NOT listed
#       here (avoids pip pulling a CPU-only build).
# ==========================================================================
transformers==4.41.2
datasets==2.19.1
accelerate==0.30.1
scikit-learn==1.4.2
pandas==2.2.2
numpy==1.26.4
tqdm==4.66.4

# Required by ALBERT's tokenizer. The 'textattack/albert-base-v2-imdb' checkpoint
# ships a SentencePiece model (spiece.model) but no pre-converted tokenizer.json,
# so transformers must convert slow -> fast at load time. Without these two,
# AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained raises:
#   "Couldn't instantiate the backend tokenizer ... You need to have
#    sentencepiece installed to convert a slow tokenizer to a fast one."
sentencepiece==0.2.0
protobuf==4.25.3
